title: A column holding "ab", "ab " and " ab" has two distinct values

source.quote: The Power BI engine automatically trims any trailing spaces that follow text data, but doesn't remove leading spaces that precede the data
source.supports: trailing spaces are dropped from stored text, leading spaces are kept

derivation: Spaces[Txt] holds 'ab', 'ab ' and ' ab'. The engine trims the trailing space of 'ab ', which makes it the same value as 'ab'. The leading space of ' ab' is kept, so it stays a separate value. 2 distinct values. The source's own example has four names collapse to two rows the same way.
